description: Contract for the backend operations layer that turns the DARK validation-agent monitoring capabilities into a running pipeline: probe -> durable hysteresis -> alert policy -> delivery. Repository default is fully DARK. Validated by tests_agent_monitor_runner.py + tests_agent_alert_sink_delivery.py.
default_posture: DARK: VALIDATION_AGENT_MONITORING_ENABLED=false, AGENT_ALERT_SINK=null, no Telegram/email destination configured. The cron may be installed while dark; every run is inert until the flag is armed.

runner.single_flight: exclusive select_for_update(nowait=True) row lock on the AgentMonitorState singleton; a concurrent run refuses immediately (exit 50).
side_effects_permitted: write the singleton AgentMonitorState row (operational metadata only)
deliver a fired alert to the configured ops alert sink
side_effects_forbidden: reading or writing any customer account, trade, or plan
touching port 8788, the trade bridge, or live MT5

exit_codes.40: alert-delivery-failure (an alert fired but could not be delivered)

flags.--dry-run: evaluate + persist state but route delivery to the NULL sink (send nothing)
flags.--synthetic-state: test-only: inject a readiness STATE, skip the network probe (never performs a broker/customer action)

durable_state.purpose: hysteresis + per-alert cooldown survive a backend restart (an in-memory tracker would re-page a still-open outage after a redeploy).
durable_state.fields: current/previous state, current band, supervised, consecutive healthy/unavailable, flap_count, alerting, last_reason, last_alerts (per-name cooldown map), last_delivery, last_probe_at, last_healthy_at, last_transition_at, run_count
durable_state.data_classification: operational metadata ONLY — never a customer, broker, credential, or account value.

VALIDATION_AGENT_MONITORING_ENABLED.meaning: master switch for the runner; default OFF

VALIDATION_AGENT_PROBE_INTERVAL_SECONDS.meaning: nominal scheduler tick; drives stale (coverage-gap) detection

VALIDATION_AGENT_STALE_DETECTION_ENABLED.meaning: page when a scheduled run was missed; default OFF so a deliberately-paused scheduler does not page

AGENT_ALERT_OWNER.meaning: NAMED human/rota an alert terminates at; required for any live sink

VALIDATION_AGENT_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.meaning: DEDICATED ops chat id; MUST differ from the customer TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID or the sink refuses to build

VALIDATION_AGENT_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.meaning: ops bot token; its OWN secret — never the customer TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (security RULE 3)

VALIDATION_AGENT_ALERT_FALLBACK_EMAIL.meaning: optional mailbox used only if the primary external sink fails; unset => fallback explicitly not configured

alert_sinks.null: sends nothing; the SAFE default that makes the absence of delivery explicit
alert_sinks.logging: durable local WARNING/ERROR log line; requires AGENT_ALERT_OWNER; no external call
alert_sinks.telegram: EXTERNAL: RealTelegramTransport._send text to the DEDICATED ops chat; requires owner + ops chat_id + ops token; refuses to build if the ops chat_id equals the customer chat_id; token never logged; bounded retry+backoff; a failed send is surfaced, never raised, and is NOT debounced
alert_sinks.email: fail-closed fallback via Django send_mail to VALIDATION_AGENT_ALERT_FALLBACK_EMAIL; None when unset

secret_safety.failure_detail: an alert delivery failure carries only an HTTP status code / api error_code / exception TYPE
secret_safety.ops_evidence: agent_monitor_status prints only sanitised enums/counters/timestamps; it omits every destination (chat id / recipient / token)

scheduler.granularity: 1 minute (finest cron supports); <= the 60s HEALTHY cadence; single-flight + durable cooldown provide the DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE cadence intent
